ZEST is a uniquely proactive cloud security platform that actually solves problems instead of just flagging them. ZEST allows enterprises to bridge the remediation gap between DevOps and Security, thereby ensuring smoother operations and improving the organization's security posture.

ZEST has helped us navigate top compliance challenges by aligning various requirements to our vulnerability management and risk remediation programs. With ZEST, remediation time has significantly reduced. Our teams are now able to proactively resolve attack paths and quickly address vulnerabilities and cloud misconfigurations with both remediation and mitigation.

What’s cool about ZEST is that it actually generates Terraform fixes for you. So instead of just telling DevOps what the issue is, you’re giving them the resolution. All they have to do is review it, say it looks good, and approve it. ZEST makes remediation fast and easy.

Not only does ZEST help us remediate GCP misconfigurations fast, it also helps us identify unmanaged cloud infrastructure outside of our Terraform deployments. ZEST has been incredibly useful in helping us prioritize drift based on contextual risks and exploitability.
